Full installation guide ↗
PERSONAL INSTALLATIONPython 3.10+ · local execution

With Git and Python installed, run these commands from a folder where you keep source code. This installs the skill for your current user.

git clone https://github.com/HemantKumar822/debloat-android.git debloat-android
python debloat-android/scripts/install_skill.py --agent codex --user

GitHub access required: the repository is currently private. Use a fresh destination folder. If you already cloned it, run the installer from that checkout instead. Existing skill installations are never overwritten.

Then ask your agent:

Use android-device-care to audit my Android, explain the findings and help me review optional changes. Ask before reading apps or changing anything.

Download the skill ↓Read the full setup guide ↗

Codex discovers project skills in .agents/skills. Start a new chat if the skill doesn’t appear.

Installation paths checked against official documentation. Live IDE and device validation is still in progress. See compatibility notes.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Will Debloat Android change anything on my phone?+

Audits never change your phone. The optional experimental workflow can disable one reviewed third-party app after explicit plan approval and restore its saved enabled state. It cannot uninstall apps, clear data or write settings. System apps remain blocked.

Do I need to root my phone?+

No root is required. You need Android SDK Platform Tools on your computer and USB debugging authorized on your phone. The skill guides you through setup.

Does my device information stay private?+

The Python tool saves reports locally and has no telemetry. Your AI agent may send tool output to its provider. Installed app names can reveal personal interests, so the skill asks before reading them.

Can it tell me which apps are safe to remove?+

Package-name clues are a starting point for research. They do not establish tracking, harmful behavior, dependencies, or safe removal. Debloat Android keeps that uncertainty visible.

Can I use it with a cloud agent?+

The agent needs local command execution on the computer connected to your phone. Installing a skill into a cloud session does not give it USB access. You can try the synthetic demo without a phone.
